text: Given a valid API key, when domotz_alerts_list is called with a valid from_time/to_time window, then it returns the account's alerts for that window; when from_time or to_time is missing, then it returns an invalid_argument envelope without calling Domotz.
evidence: dev-leg note: tests relocated from the design's suggested test_tools.py-only placement — missing-argument behaviour is a generic EnvelopeFastMCP path (test_tools.py), while the mocked-HTTP window/filter behaviour follows this repo's existing convention of living in test_api_client.py (see test_outlet_control_requires_confirm). `uv run pytest -k alert -v` on 4f12b5a: all 3 tests PASSED (58 passed, 186 deselected, 1 warning in 1.54s).

text: Given more alerts than fit one page, when domotz_alerts_list is called with page_size/offset, then it returns has_more and next_offset the same way every other list tool does.
evidence: dev-leg note: test_page_size_capped_at_200 is parametrized over a fixed tool list in this repo (not auto-applied to every paged tool) — added domotz_alerts_list to that list. The page/offset mechanics themselves reuse locate()/page_result(), already covered generically by test_cut_pages_continue_without_gaps_* in test_api_client.py. `uv run pytest -k alert -v` on 4f12b5a: test_page_size_capped_at_200[domotz_alerts_list] PASSED.

text: Given an alert_id, when domotz_alerts_resolve is called without confirm: true, then it returns sent: false and Domotz is never called.
evidence: `uv run pytest -k alert -v` on 4f12b5a: test_alerts_resolve_requires_confirm PASSED. Asserts result["sent"] is False and rec.requests == [] (mock transport never called).

text: Given an alert_id and confirm: true, when domotz_alerts_resolve is called, then it calls POST /alert/{alert_id}/resolve and returns sent: true.
evidence: `uv run pytest -k alert -v` on 4f12b5a: test_alerts_resolve_sends_when_confirmed PASSED. Asserts rec.calls("alert/3/resolve", "POST") and result == {sent: true, alert_id: 3, ...}.

text: Given a real Domotz test account, when an agent resolves a real alert end to end, then the alert shows resolved in the Domotz portal.
steps: Obtain a Domotz trial/test account API key
Trigger or find a currently-open alert
Call domotz_alerts_resolve with confirm: true for that alert_id
Check the Domotz portal for the alert's status
expect: The alert shows resolved in the Domotz portal
evidence: needs a real vendor account — not available at design or dev time; see references/mcp-track.md 2.5 (no test account does not block this ticket)

text: Given a valid API key, when domotz_alert_rules_list is called, then it returns the account's Alert Rules; when domotz_alert_rules_get is called with an unknown alert_rule_id, then it returns a not_found envelope.
evidence: `uv run pytest -k alert -v` on 4f12b5a: both PASSED. not_found path exercised via a mocked 404 from Domotz, classified by the existing DomotzError/classify_status mapping (no new error-mapping code).

text: Given an alert_rule_id and agent_id, when domotz_alert_rules_bind_agent / domotz_alert_rules_unbind_agent are called without confirm: true, then they return sent: false; with confirm: true, then they call POST / DELETE on the agent binding path.
evidence: dev-leg note: the two confirm-gate cases were merged into one parametrized test (test_alert_rule_binding_requires_confirm) matching this repo's existing style for the per-endpoint-path tests. `uv run pytest -k alert -v` on 4f12b5a: all 4 PASSED.

text: Given an alert_rule_id, agent_id and device_id, when domotz_alert_rules_bind_device / domotz_alert_rules_unbind_device are called without confirm: true, then they return sent: false; with confirm: true, then they call POST / DELETE on the device binding path.
evidence: `uv run pytest -k alert -v` on 4f12b5a: all 4 PASSED (same parametrized-test note as TC6).

text: Given no credentials, when tools/list is called, then all 8 new tools are listed; given a 401/404/429/5xx response from Domotz, when any new tool is called, then it returns the matching error envelope code.
evidence: `uv run pytest -q` on 4f12b5a: 244 passed (was 193 before this change: 21 pre-existing tools x generic per-tool checks + shared tests; 8 new tools added to EXPECTED_TOOLS, picked up automatically by the generic parametrized checks). Live smoke test (initialize+tools/list with placeholder X-Domotz-API-Key, local server on :18099): tools/list returned exactly the 29 expected tool names, including all 8 new ones with the required-param sets matching the design table; request to /mcp with no header returned HTTP 401; GET /health returned 200.

text: Given the full existing test suite, when it is run after this change, then all pre-existing tools (21) keep their exact tools/list snapshot and parameter-type contract.
evidence: `uv run pytest -q` on 4f12b5a: 244 passed, 0 failed, 1 pre-existing unrelated deprecation warning (starlette TestClient). No pre-existing test was modified except EXPECTED_TOOLS/WRITE_TOOLS/DESTRUCTIVE_TOOLS additions and the page_size parametrize list in test_tools.py (adding new entries, not changing existing ones) and the destructiveHint assertion split into WRITE_TOOLS vs DESTRUCTIVE_TOOLS (see Self-test note on ALERT_ACTION); test_contract_types.py untouched and green for all 21 pre-existing tools.
